notes: Use an explicit Speech baseUrl, for example https://eastus.tts.speech.microsoft.com. This is not an Azure OpenAI deployment route. Enable media.http.enabled separately.

The standard audio/speech adapter requires a native voice such as en-US-Harper:MAI-Voice-2-Flash. It maps text to SSML and mp3/wav/pcm to explicit Speech formats. It does not map OpenAI voice aliases or transcode audio.
The native /v1/providers/azure-speech/{publicModel}/speech endpoint accepts SSML and X-Microsoft-OutputFormat. All voices must select this model. Custom voice management is out of scope.
